description: Automated multi-agent pipeline. v4.6.0 (Slice 3b): imports prescriptive 13-step Pulsar Implement_new_feature workflow as single skill `feature` with mode flag (heavy|light) — pattern novo vs Slice 1.5/3a (2 skills separadas).
